person: Marcus Webb is a 45-year-old physical therapist in Tacoma, laid off from a hospital system and now working per diem, so every dollar matters. He returned a leased 2023 Subaru Outback three weeks ago and got a lease-end statement for 2,785 dollars, about 900 of it labeled excess wear on a car he thinks was in good shape. He is the household spreadsheet person, checks every line's math, and answers to his wife, who wants money back. He wants to dispute only what the lease and inspection actually support and to be told plainly which charges he should just pay.
stated_up_front: The leasing company sent me a $2,785 lease-end bill and I think some of the wear charges are bogus. Check each line against my lease's wear limits and the inspector's measurements, show me the math, and tell me which ones I should just pay.

facts.truth: $2,785.00, which he expects to see broken into lines that add up exactly
He drove about 1,900 miles over the 36,000 allowed; he knows he went over and expects to pay it
$395, named in his lease; he assumes it is legitimate
Inspector measured 38 mm; he thinks the lease allows dents up to about 2 inches, so he wants it disputed
Rear tire at 5/32 inch he believes is within limit; front tire at 3/32 inch he accepts as worn out

facts.about: windshield chip, wheel scuff and seat stain
facts.truth: Chip 12 mm, wheel scuff 20 mm, seat stain 18 mm; he took photos of all three before returning the car
A long bumper scratch from a parking garage, a cracked headlight lens, a gouged wheel and a cigarette-style seat burn from a passenger; he does not expect to dispute these
He returned the car on 2 October 2026 and took photos the evening before, on 1 October
The statement already applies a wear allowance credit that he does not recall being told about
Get the unsupported wear charges removed, with a written dispute he can show his wife, and no claims that every charge is wrong

unknowns: The exact dent, chip, scuff and stain size limits written in his lease
The tread depth below which the lease counts a tire as worn
How much the wear allowance credit is worth or what it covers
Whether the lessor has a deadline for disputing charges after the statement date
